rigidAxioms: 5-layer decoupled architecture: Facade -> Controller -> Model -> Storage -> UI View unidirectional data flow.
Crash-safe RingBuffer & Journal: In-memory ring buffer with incremental journal append for zero data loss on crash.
Zero runtime bloat: No heavy third-party packages; sub-second startup time.
100% bilingual dictionary closure: All UI text & notifications routed through zh-CN/en dictionaries; zero raw strings.
UI physics & styling guards: Single border, semantic lightness scale; zero visual stutter or redundant borders.
Size budget & build hygiene: tsconfig declaration: false; package size strictly bounded within budget.
Headless automated testability: In-memory test harnesses for core models; deterministic mock environments.
SSOT rule closure: All extension lifecycle rules registered in rule-catalog.json (RCFG-RULE-DRIFT).
